entities.name: Rayon (First Synthetic Fiber)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Count Hilaire de Chardonnet created "artificial silk" from cellulose dissolved in chemical solvents. Rayon looked like silk at a fraction of the cost. It was the first commercially successful synthetic fiber.
